caption: The drawing depicts a single object: a glass pitcher. The pitcher is rendered in shades of blue and turquoise, with translucent qualities that suggest it is made of glass. The body of the pitcher is vertically ribbed and features repeating curved patterns, giving it a decorative texture. The top edge of the pitcher is scalloped, with both concave and convex curves. The spout is rounded and extends outward, while the handle is also curved and attached to the upper right side, matching the pitcher’s color and glass-like material. The background of the drawing is a uniform off-white or beige color, without any additional objects or details. There is a small, simple signature or monogram in black at the lower center of the drawing near the base of the pitcher.
title: Water Pitcher
